citations.quote: A popular alternative to RDU for Case 1 is the maxmin expected utility (MEU) model, also sometimes referred to using the general name multiple priors
If W is convex then its CORE is nonempty and W is the minimum over all of its CORE elements.
It became popular in decision theory when Gilboa & Schmeidler (1989) proved its soundness by providing a behavioral foundation.

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Maxmin expected utility (Gilboa-Schmeidler) evaluates a prospect as the minimum expected utility over a convex set of priors C; it equals Choquet EU when C is the CORE of a convex capacity, and the alpha-maxmin model blends the worst-case inf with the best-case sup.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Multiple Priors and Maxmin Expected Utility
